messages:
Nora Alvarez: Quick status on SummitGrid case study — customer call went well. They approved quotes and want a short hero quote plus longer transcript excerpts. Publish target is Tue 06/08 09:00 PT (embargo).
Samir Desai: I'll own sign-off. Uploaded transcript + clips to Drive. Need legal to confirm redactions and benchmark phrasing.
Riley Park: I can do creative. Customer provided an architecture screenshot; will check for logos/branding permissions. Plan: hero image + 4 social sizes + 2 promo vids (15s + 60s).
LegalBot: Started review: please attach methodology note for the benchmark numbers and a signed release. Redact any internal emails/PII in the transcript.
Nora Alvarez: Draft hero quote from call: "Redwood helped us stabilize production latency and accelerate feature delivery." Customer prefers keeping it succinct.
Samir Desai: Sending revised quote to customer: "Redwood reduced our production latency and let us ship faster." Also requesting permission to publish the benchmark snapshot (internal test ID S-2026-77).
Marcos Ruiz: Ops note: create HubSpot form with tag "summitgrid-case-2026" and routing to AE + CS for expansion follow-up. Recommend gating the one-pager to collect MQL info.
LegalBot: Release uploaded and signed: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/summitgrid/RELEASE_1789456420.pdf. Legal recommends "approximately 40% lower median latency" phrasing and citation to S-2026-77. All redactions done.
Riley Park: Thanks — I'll avoid competitor comparisons and keep benchmark blurb per legal. ETA for final exports: Fri 06/05 EOD.
Samir Desai: Customer preview requested for Monday 06/07. I'll post the landing draft and hero image link here for their sign-off.
Nora Alvarez: Great. Team assignments: Samir -> customer sign-off + landing copy; Riley -> creative + clips; Marcos -> HubSpot + gated one-pager; LegalBot -> completed. We'll reconvene here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
